messages:
maria-g: FYI - Orion notified ops that a midwest crossdock diverted part of our shipment. 2 racks of rtxA100-80GB were rerouted to Warehouse-E. ETA slipped ~5 business days. This hits reserved Dedicated capacity and some marketplace allocations.

ajay-p: Ugh. Which reservations? can we map to committed customers?

maria-g: quick list below (just the IDs for now):
```
DED-ACME-2026-07 (50 GPUs)
DED-BRIGHT-2026-09 (20 GPUs)
MKT-QUE-8891 (25 GPUs queued)
MKT-PRIO-421 (10 GPUs, marketplace premium)
```

kevin-s: tagging @emily-j for routing policy — we may need to pull from buffer pool in ap-south or swap preemptible pools. Any constraints from the Dedicated contracts?

emily-j: DED-ACME has SLA that requires <100ms p95 latency; we can’t route to ap-south w/o confirming model variants & warmup. But we can offer short-term burst from our reserved overflow in us-west-2 (30 GPUs). That buys ~48-72h.

maria-g: ok can we confirm costs + customer comms? Sam, heads up — Acme will be affected if we can’t secure those 50 GPUs in region.

sam-customer-succ: thanks. I’ll draft a cautious note for Acme and suggest a canary fallback to a quantized variant to reduce GPU requirement if they prefer no service interruption. Prefer we avoid broad SLAs change.

vendor-orion-ops-bot: auto-update: Warehouse-E processing backlog + customs hold flagged for 12 pallets; expected clearance + transfer: 4-6 business days. Carrier ETA pending. Tracking: ORION-TRK-7753.

ajay-p: Two asks: 1) Maria/Emily — commit to fallback plan (region swap + burst) and confirm exact hours until replacement racks arrive. 2) Partnerships — negotiate a marketplace credit for affected queued buyers (MKT-QUE-8891 & MKT-PRIO-421).

emily-j: I can confirm burst for 30 GPUs in us-west-2 for 72h starting now. That leaves 20 GPUs short for ACME. We can either: a) provide quantized variant for remaining 20 (with customer opt-in), b) split ACME across legacy nodes (risk >100ms) — need legal signoff.

kevin-s: Ops suggestion: do fast pull from node warmers (we currently have 12 warmed t4 nodes) + enable aggressive KV caching on ACME model to reduce token compute. Might reduce effective GPU need by ~15%. Not perfect, but combined with 30 GPU burst + quantization we can cover ACME for 48h.

maria-g: I'll negotiate with Orion for expedited crossdock & request a partial credit for marketplace customers. Also pinging HW partner success to push a prioritized manifest.

sam-customer-succ: I'll get a draft notice to ACME by EOD: explain temporary routing + degraded perf if they decline quantized variant, offer 10% service credit for impacted window.

ajay-p: Please add a short internal blurb for sales ops so they don’t promise capacity that’s not there. Also log this as a potential prioritization precedent if we give credits.

emily-j: Logging runbook steps now. If ORION can't meet 4 business days we need to trigger longer-term redistribution and reserve replenishment with procurement.

vendor-orion-ops-bot: update: carrier confirmed earlier depot handoff window +1 business day. New estimated transfer completion: 3-5 business days.

maria-g: For next steps: 1) Emily to enact 30 GPU burst (in progress). 2) Kevin to apply KV caching + warmers (in progress). 3) Sam to send ACME note (drafted). 4) Maria to negotiate partial credit with Orion and request manifest priority. Report back in this thread in 2 hours. :thumbsup:

kevin-s: started cache tweak + warmers; will post logs if any failures.

emily-j: burst initiated, will monitor latency charts and cost delta.

ajay-p: Thanks all. If vendor credit approved, partnerships will propose a marketplace credit formula (pro-rata tokens + expedited shipping offset).
